## Custom chunk hooks

We can define a hook that wraps a chunk's output in a `div` of our choosing:

```{r}
knitr::knit_hooks$set(class = function(before, options, envir) {
  if(before){
    sprintf("<div class='%s'>", options$class)
  }else{
    "</div>"
  }
})
```

Then in the chunk, we can use the new hook thusly:

`````{verbatim}
```{r example-plot, class="blue-outline"}
plot(1:10, pch=21, bg="blue")
```
`````

🤮

### Pro-tip: double code fences

Wondering how I got the previous line of code to print?
It was not quite obvious.
See the [double code fences](https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/NEWS.md#new-features-1=) trick.
**tl;dr** uses the code type `{verbatim}`.
